# deed_entities (Data Source)

Searches entities (effective view) the token can read, ordered by name. All filters are optional and combined with AND.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "deed_entities" "storage" {
  project = "homelab"
  kind    = "server"
  labels  = { tier = "storage" }
}

output "storage_servers" {
  value = [for e in data.deed_entities.storage.entities : e.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Only entities of this kind.
- `labels` (Map of String) Only entities carrying every one of these labels.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of entities to return (default: all).
- `project` (String) Only entities in this project (name or ID).
- `q` (String) Full-text search (names, descriptions, labels, spec values, external IDs).

### Read-Only

- `entities` (Attributes List) Matching entities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entities))
- `id` (String) Identifier of this search.
- `ids` (List of String) IDs of the matching entities.

<a id="nestedatt--entities"></a>
